responsibility: Implements RTL dead store elimination using a multi-stage pipeline that combines local cselib-based store tracking, global backward dataflow for selected address classes, and a post-RA spill-slot-specific treatment. It scans instructions to classify stores and reads, builds per-block and global store information, solves the dead-store dataflow problem, deletes globally or locally dead stores, removes repeated stores of the same value when earlier stores must remain, and cleans up EH edges and alias-analysis state after eliminating trapping MEM writes.
